definitions.archive_records: Inspectable records that do not clear all public evidence gates.
definitions.benchmark_controls: Position records with scoreboard_role=benchmark_control; reported separately and excluded from school rankings.
definitions.completed_review_logs: Tracked review/log/*.md excluding README.md. Internal audit notes are not counted as external peer review.
definitions.featured_evidence: Public-visible causal records without screening markers.
definitions.hypothesis_specs: Hypothesis specs available in the published site, excluding source-rights holds.
definitions.positions: Tracked positions/*.yaml school or benchmark records, excluding underscore-prefixed derived indexes.
definitions.public_visible_results: Evidence-qualified results available in the published site; source-rights holds are counted separately.
definitions.publication_rights_held_evidence_qualifi: Evidence-qualified records held from publication during publisher-rights review.
definitions.publication_rights_held_records: Research records held from publication during publisher-rights review; evidence grades are unchanged.
definitions.reference_set: Hand-audited exemplars; not peer review and not a substitute for the evidence tier.
definitions.result_card_files: Result cards available in the published site, excluding source-rights holds.
definitions.run_directories: Result runs available in the published site, excluding source-rights holds.
